defs.def: an instrument for measuring and showing time, in a room or on the wall of a building (not worn or carried like a watch) 时钟；钟

ex.s: Recently，I conceptualized a new approach to timekeeping that's connected to circumstances on our planet，conditions that might change as a result of global warming．We're now building a clock at the Anchorage Museum that reflects the total flow of several major Alaskan rivers，which are sensitive to local and global environmental changes．We've programmed it to match an atomic clock if the waterways continue to flow at their present rate．If the rivers run faster in the future on average，the clock will get ahead of standard time．If they run slower，you'll see the opposite effect．
ex.t: 最近，我构想了一种与地球环境状况相关的新计时方法，而这些状况可能因全球变暖而改变。我们现在正在安克雷奇博物馆建造一座时钟，它反映阿拉斯加几条主要河流的总流量，这些河流对地方和全球的环境变化十分敏感。我们已对它编程：如果水道继续以目前速率流动，它就与原子钟同步；如果未来河流平均流速加快，时钟就会跑在标准时间前面；如果变慢，则会出现相反效果。

ex.s: I forget to wind up the clock.
In Newton’s era, we imagined the universe as a clock.
ex.t: 在牛顿的时代，我们把宇宙想象成一座钟。

ex.s: There is no point in arguing if the universe is a clock, a set of particles or an output of computation.
ex.t: 争论宇宙是一座钟、一组粒子还是计算的输出，是毫无意义的。

ex.s: Set your alarm clock an hour early and push yourself to work out!
ex.t: 把闹钟调早一小时，逼自己去锻炼！

ex.s: Lots of people find it hard to get up in the morning and put the blame on the alarm clock.
ex.t: 很多人发现早上起床很困难，并把责任归咎于闹钟。

ex.s: Among these is the clock restoration master, Wang Jin.
ex.t: 其中就有钟表修复大师王进。

ex.s: Qing emperors were very fond of clocks.
ex.t: 清朝皇帝非常喜欢钟表。

ex.s: Day in, day out, Mr Wang and his students spend their time restoring clocks dating back hundreds of years.
ex.t: 日复一日，王先生和他的学生们花时间修复可追溯到数百年前的时钟。

ex.s: In fact, the key to easy morning wake-up lies in resting your body clock   36     Here is how to make one.
ex.t: 实际上，轻松早起的关键在于调整你的生物钟   36     以下是如何做到这一点的方法。

ex.s: The parent argued that none of her friends’ parents let them have screens after 9 o’clock.
ex.t: 那位家长争辩说，她朋友的父母都不让孩子在9点后碰屏幕。

ex.s: She never minded the alarm clock sounding at 4 am or questioned my expenses on running.
ex.t: 她从不介意凌晨4点的闹钟响起，也不质疑我在跑步上的开销。

ex.s: How long we stay on the clock and how we spend that time are under careful examination in many workplaces.
ex.t: 我们坚持时间有多长，我们花费的时间如何在许多工作场所受到认真审查。

ex.s: Are you one of those people who work around the clock?
ex.t: 您是那些全天候工作的人之一吗？

ex.s: Where will Mr White be at 11 o’clock?
A GI could, its advocates say, work for us around the clock, and drawing on all available data, could suggest solutions to many problems.
ex.t: 其支持者说，AGI可以日夜不停地为我们工作，并借助一切可用数据，为许多问题提出解决方案。

ex.s: Some people seem willing to work around the clock in their narrow specialty.
ex.t: 有些人似乎愿意在自己狭窄的专业领域夜以继日地工作。

defs.def: the distance that a vehicle has travelled, as shown by the milometer （车辆里程表记录的）里程
to return to a situation that existed in the past; to remember a past age 倒退；复旧；怀旧

ex.s: "We took these 50-year-old hearts and turned the clock back to 30-or 35-year-old hearts," says Levine.
ex.t: "我们把这些50岁的心脏倒退回了30或35岁的心脏，"Levine说。

defs.def: to return to old-fashioned methods or ideas 开倒车
to reach a particular time or speed 达到（某时间或速度）
to measure the speed at which sb/sth is travelling 测 … 的速度
to notice or recognize sb 注意到；认出

to illegally reduce the number of miles shown on a vehicle's milometer (= instrument that measures the number of miles it has travelled) in order to make the vehicle appear to have travelled fewer miles than it really has 非法减少（车辆）计程器上的里程数；回拨（车辆）里程表作弊
